neighbours.label: the word 'repeat' and its forms (repeat, repeated, repeating; the card also shows 重复 and 반복), not the idea of doing something again in other words
fire: Could you repeat the question for the people at the back?
The parrot repeated every word the sailor said.
History keeps repeating itself in this small town.
Rinse the cloth, wring it out, and repeat the process twice.
She repeated the warning three times before leaving.
The chorus is repeated after each verse of the song.
The pattern goes on repeating across the whole wall.
Students who fail the exam must repeat the year.
quiet: Could you answer the question for the people at the back?
The parrot copied every word the sailor said.
History keeps surprising everyone in this small town.
Rinse the cloth, wring it out, and do the process again.
She gave the warning three times before leaving.
The chorus is sung once more after each verse of the song.
The pattern goes on and on across the whole wall.
Students who fail the exam must retake the year.

notes: Card: repeat/repeated/Repeat/repeating plus Chinese and Korean equivalents, max 106. Probes: 'repeat' 0.81, while 'again and again' 0.12 and 'once more' 0.10, so the near misses keep the meaning (again, once more, copied, retake) and drop the word.
